note: RFC 5282 Section 3.2 forbids AES CCM ICV lengths other than 8, 12 and 16 octets; Section 7.2 assigns those sizes to Transform IDs 14, 15 and 16. TestRFC5282CCMRefusesEveryOtherICVLength asserts each CCM ID's exact AEADICVOctets result and actual sealed expansion, then requires ErrDecryptionFailed and no plaintext for authentic CCM ciphertexts with each other primitive-supported ICV size (4, 6, 10 and 14). These inputs retain valid key, salt, nonce and associated data, so they isolate the forbidden ICV size rather than corrupted or truncated tags. TestRFC5282CCMSupportsTheThreePermittedICVLengths is the non-blanket-refusal control: all three permitted sizes seal with exact expansion and open to the original plaintext. The profile constrains CCM, not unrelated AEAD registry entries. Native rfc record observed the positive unit fail at its exact metadata assertion for all three IDs when generated gomu selector internal/component/ike/crypto/aead.go:120:5#1 removed the AEADICVOctets guard negation, producing zero and ErrUnsupportedAlgorithm for registered CCM IDs. That observed break proves metadata discrimination, not a separate observation of forbidden-size acceptance or external peer interoperability.
